title: Understanding MSE on Test Data
text: When you remove a feature from a model, it can affect the model's ability to generalize to new data. Consider how this might impact the Mean Squared Error (MSE) on held-out test data.

title: Effect of Feature Removal on Bias
text: Removing a feature can increase the bias of the model because the model might lose some information that was useful for making predictions.

title: Effect of Feature Removal on Variance
text: Removing a feature can decrease the variance of the model because the model becomes simpler and less sensitive to fluctuations in the training data.

title: Possible Effects on MSE
text: Consider the trade-off between bias and variance when a feature is removed. How might this trade-off affect the MSE on held-out test data?
